headline: US Employers Add 165,000 Jobs in October as Unemployment Falls to 4.1%
summary: The US economy added 165,000 jobs in October, surpassing expectations as the unemployment rate declined to 4.1%, signaling sustained labor market strength.
why: Nonfarm payrolls and unemployment data are primary indicators evaluated by the Federal Reserve to guide interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected payrolls and lower unemployment lift expectations for tighter monetary policy.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Rising expectations of interest rate hikes generally strengthen the domestic currency.
